name: Pledge swapTokenU sells the contract's MFT to any caller-named target
summary: Pledge.swapTokenU(amount, target) was public and sold the contract's own MFT for USDT to a caller-chosen recipient, so the attacker sold 989.6M MFT from the contract into the MFT/USDT pair and received its USDT, 10 days after deployment.
notes: MFT is unpriced; it is valued at the 14,994.30 USDT its sale realised in the same transaction (rule 12).
